svg.title: CSG geometry, object-owned regions, spatial material fields, and FDM vs FEM realization
svg.desc: Three-panel comparison: (a) Authored CSG Box minus Cylinder with an ObjectRegion core override, object vs world coordinate frames, and spatial MaterialParameterField profile; (b) FDM Cartesian discretization with active masks, region indices, and boundary transition cells; (c) FEM single shared conforming tetrahedral/triangular domain with airbox, hole boundary markers, and local region mesh grading.
svg.text: Geometry, Object-Owned Regions, Material Fields, and Backend Discretization
One authored physical intent lowered into structured FDM cell masks or a single conforming FEM shared domain
yobj across 'core' override (linear in object frame)
Authoring preserves AST & frames; no mesh generated here.
Structured grid (Δx, Δy, Δz), active mask A, region index ri
Base film cell: active=1, ri=0, Ms=800 kA/m
Core region cell: active=1, ri=1, Ms(xi,yi)
• Staircase mask A excludes hole & exterior vacuum
• Region exchange Aab evaluated across ri ≠ rj faces
• Periodicity & multilayer grids are separate contracts
No overlapping subgrids; single active-cell ownership.
Conforming Ωm ⊂ Ωa triangles, markers & local grading
Airbox elements Ωa ∖ Ωm (Ms=0; marker Γa)
• Element markers partition Ωm = ⋃ Ωi, Ωi ∩ Ωj = ∅
• Material fields evaluated at nodes or quadrature points
Region mesh(...) guides shared mesh size grading only.
